title: Topological line arrangements and their topological invariants
summary: A topological line arrangement is an arrangement of embedded spheres in the complex projective plane that topologically generalizes a complex line arrangement. In this paper, we establish foundational results on the topology of the complement of topological line arrangements. First, we prove that the cohomology ring of the complement is isomorphic to the Orlik-Solomon algebra, as for classical complex line arrangements. We then study the homotopy type of the complement.
